_about: Hand-maintained India calendar for the Markets panel's Calendar tab (app/domain/market_calendar.py). Dates were checked on 2026-10-08 against the sources below; a date that changes after that is NOT picked up automatically, so refresh this file when the exchanges or MoSPI publish next year's calendars (it runs out at the end of March 2027). MoSPI publishes dates only, not times, and says a date that falls on a holiday moves to the next working day (the code applies that to weekends). MCX session status for September to December comes from broker republications of the MCX circular (Jainam, Upstox); confirm on mcxindia.com.
